caption: The drawing depicts the interior of a classic apothecary or pharmacy with a checkered black-and-white tile floor. Both side walls are lined with wooden shelves filled with numerous glass jars and bottles, most of which are white or transparent and uniformly arranged. There are glass display cases on either side and in the center foreground, showcasing a variety of smaller bottles, boxes, and possibly instruments. The central back wall features a large glass window labeled "PRESCRIPTION DEPARTMENT" with an image of a mortar and pestle. Above the window, there is a round clock set into ornate woodwork. The ceiling is green with decorative paneling and a large, intricate chandelier hangs in the center. The upper walls display painted classical friezes depicting figures, and several large, colored glass vessels (blue, green, red) are suspended at intervals. Additional light fixtures with ornate designs and glass shades or globes are mounted on the walls or hanging from the ceiling. The overall color palette includes muted greens, browns, golds, and creams, with accents of color from the glass vessels and lights. The furniture and cabinetry are highly decorated with intricate carvings and trim.
title: Drug Store
